desc:
⚽ Welcome to $20 Draft for Soccer Cards!

Challenge other players in exciting auction battles, spend your cash wisely, and collect legendary Soccer Cards!

✅ How to Play:

🪑 Find an open table and take a seat

💰 Bid against another player

🏆 Win auctions and expand your card collection

📈 Earn cash from your cards, even while offline

🍀 Upgrade your luck to discover better players

🎁 Invite friends and build the ultimate collection together  

Leave a like and join our group to support the game!

by ParadoV 💙
